title: Blockus Party
description:
Welcome to the ultimate geometric showdown.

BLOCKUS PARTY is a high-energy, chaotic digital board game where shapes collide and friendships are put to the test. Whether you are playing solo or hosting a 10-player Super Party, every roll of the dice brings new strategy, wacky physics, and cosmic competition.

MEET THE SQUADChoose from a diverse roster of 12 unique geometric contenders including Blockus, Cuboidus, and Star Hero! Every character brings their own aesthetic flair to the board.

17 THRILLING MINIGAMESFrom memory trials to high-intensity battles, compete in a massive library of games that keep the energy high.

Action and Survival Lava Hopper, Cosmo Grapple, Block Dash, Block Breaker, and Carpet Bomber.

Strategy and Skill Blockus King, Color Swapper, Paint Blaster, Block Stacker, and Boss Arena.

Memory and Logic Shape Matcher, Block Memory, and Blockus Maze

Racing and Collection Color Racer, Color Collector, Hot Blocks, and Brainrot Battle.

SUPER PARTY SUPPORTBring the whole crew. BLOCKUS PARTY supports up to 10 players simultaneously. No extra controllers? No problem. Players can join the game using their smartphones as controllers via a web browser.
description_short: Geometry gets chaotic in BLOCKUS PARTY, a 10-player board game where 12 unique characters battle across 17 minigames. Use your phone as a controller, navigate the Cosmic Realm, and secure victory with the Prime Polyhedron's Endgame stars. High-speed, geometric fun for the whole squad!
